label: Acts and 2 Corinthians attest a Christian gathering at Alexandria Troas

date.note: Paul's second and third journeys (c. 50 and c. 57) per the Pauline chronology; 2 Cor is undisputed Pauline and the Acts passage is a first-person 'we' section, so the source is contemporary with the community.

secondary.cite: Harnack, Mission and Expansion, vol. 2, pp. 185–186

notes: Alexandria Troas (Pleiades 550434), the settlement, not the Troad region (550944). Acts 20.7 describes the community gathered to break bread on the first day of the week. Harnack also cites Ignatius (ad Phil. 11), who wrote from Troas c. 110; that later attestation is left for a separate item.
